name: Pasea Hotel & Spa
positioning: Contemporary beach hotel across from the sand in Huntington Beach, with a Balinese-inspired spa and a rooftop bar
best_for: Couples wanting a spa stay steps from the beach
Travelers who want to walk to the pier, downtown and Pacific City

facts.text: The hotel is across from the beach, a short walk from the Huntington Beach Pier.
Downtown Huntington Beach and the pier are 0.6 miles from the hotel.
Pacific City, with oceanfront dining, shopping and entertainment, is next door.
The suites, guest rooms and studios have a contemporary beach style and views of PCH.
Accommodations include ocean front one-bedroom suites and the Pasea Penthouse.
Aarna Spa was named one of the Top 100 Spas in 2025 by Spas of America.
Aarna Spa has separate men's and women's saunas and steam rooms.
Ninth Island Pool has a hot tub and a whirlpool.
Guests can reserve poolside daybeds or full-service private cabanas.
At Lorea, the signature restaurant, guests can view the ocean while dining on locally sourced cuisine.
The daily resort fee includes bike rentals.

highlights.text: Aarna Spa is Balinese-inspired, with a private outdoor spa garden.
The spa has a saltwater pool with plush loungers and a tranquil courtyard.
Treehouse on PCH is a rooftop bar with 360-degree views of the Pacific Ocean and Surf City.
Guests can gather around beach bonfires just steps from the hotel.
Seasonal beach butler transportation is included in the daily resort fee.

considerations.text: The hotel sits across from the beach rather than on the sand, and rooms look out over PCH.
Aarna Spa welcomes guests 18 or older, and Treehouse on PCH is 21 and over.
